name: techland-fullstack
//type: The serverless functions in /api are ES modules. Without this, Node and the Vercel runtime parse them as CommonJS and the import statements throw at cold start. frontend/ and backend/ have their own package.json, so this does not affect them.

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../Admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run admin"
